title: Aspect Deep 7: Aspect in the Conditional
description: The conditional is built from past-tense forms with бы. Aspect choice in if-clauses and result-clauses follows the same rules as in the plain past.
descriptionRussian: Условное наклонение строится из формы прошедшего времени плюс частицы бы. Выбор вида в придаточном и главном предложениях подчиняется тем же правилам, что и в обычном прошедшем времени.
intro: The construction is new and the aspect logic is not. A Russian conditional is built out of past-tense forms, so every decision you already make in the past carries over unchanged. That is the whole rule in one sentence, which leaves room to get comfortable with a sentence shape you will need constantly and that looks nothing like the English one.
rules: The Russian conditional is built from past-tense forms with бы: 'Если бы [past] [past] бы [...]'. The form is the same regardless of past, present, or future hypothetical meaning.
Aspect in the conditional follows the same rules as in the past tense. Use the past-tense decision tree from earlier lessons, then apply бы.
Impf-only verbs (знать, любить, хотеть, быть, мочь) keep the imperfective in the conditional: 'Если бы я знал...'
Frequency / duration cues keep the imperfective. Completion adverbs and bounded results keep the perfective.
examples: Если бы я знал её адрес, я бы написал ей. (If I had known her address, I would have written to her.) Impf state verb + pf single-event.
Если бы ты прочитал статью, ты бы согласился. (If you had read the article through, you would have agreed.) Two perfectives: completed reading, completed agreement.
Если бы мы часто встречались, мы бы лучше друг друга понимали. (If we met often, we would understand each other better.) Frequency cue → impf in both clauses.
Если бы Маша уже сделала работу, она бы отдыхала сейчас. (If Masha had already finished the work, she would be resting now.) Уже → pf in if-clause; ongoing state → impf in result.
Если бы Антон не потерял ключи, он бы открыл дверь. (If Anton hadn't lost the keys, he would have opened the door.) Pf negation in if-clause: action did happen but speaker is hypothesizing it didn't.
Если бы я каждый день учил язык, я бы говорил свободно. (If I studied the language every day, I would speak fluently.) Frequency cue → impf in if-clause.

rows.label: If-clause
cells: Same rules as plain past tense

rows.label: Result-clause
cells: Same rules as plain past tense

items.promptEnglish: I love drinking coffee in the mornings.
items.hint: Recap from Lesson 6: любить + infinitive defaults to which aspect?
items.explanation: Recap from Lesson 6: любить is a verb of general preference and takes an imperfective infinitive. Люблю пить. Today's lesson moves to a different mood: the conditional, where past-tense aspect rules apply unchanged.

items.prompt: Если бы ты _____ эту книгу, ты бы понял мою точку зрения.
items.promptEnglish: If you had read this book through, you would have understood my point of view.
items.hint: Single completed hypothetical event with a specific object. Past-tense rule carries over.
items.explanation: Specific object 'эту книгу' plus the implied completion (the result-clause depends on the book having been read through). Perfective past + бы: прочитал. The imperfective читал would describe a hypothetical reading-process, which the result-clause does not depend on.

items.prompt: Если бы я _____ её адрес, я бы написал ей раньше.
items.promptEnglish: If I had known her address, I would have written to her earlier.
items.hint: Recap from Lesson 6 / A2 Aspect Intro Lesson 6: which verbs are impf-only?
items.explanation: Знать is an imperfective-only state verb (recap from A2 Aspect Intro Lesson 6). It stays imperfective in the conditional. Past masc -л: знал. Distractor 'узнал' means 'found out, recognized,' a different lexical event from stative knowing.

items.prompt: Если бы мы _____ статью к утру, мы бы сейчас отдыхали.
items.promptEnglish: If we had written the article by morning, we would be resting now.
items.hint: 'К утру' is which kind of cue from A2 Aspect Intro Lesson 5?
items.explanation: 'К утру' is a deadline cue (recap from A2 Aspect Intro Lesson 5) and locks in the perfective. The conditional does not change this rule. Past plural -ли + бы: написали. The result-clause 'отдыхали бы' is imperfective because resting is an ongoing process.

items.prompt: Если бы Маша часто _____ английский, она бы говорила свободно.
items.promptEnglish: If Masha studied English often, she would speak it fluently.
items.hint: Часто is a frequency cue. Frequency rule carries over to the conditional.
items.explanation: Часто is a frequency cue (recap from Lesson 2 and A2 Aspect Intro Lesson 4) and locks in the imperfective. The conditional does not change this rule. Past fem -ла + бы: учила. The perfective выучила would describe a single completed mastering, which 'often' rules out.

items.prompt: Если бы Антон не _____ ключи, он бы открыл дверь.
items.promptEnglish: If Anton hadn't lost the keys, he would have opened the door.
items.hint: Single completed hypothetical event in the if-clause. Negative + pf.
items.explanation: The if-clause hypothesizes a single completed event (the keys getting lost). Не + perfective: не потерял. The imperfective не терял would mean 'wasn't habitually losing keys,' a frequency / habit reading that the result-clause does not need.

items.prompt: Если бы я знал её адрес, _____.
items.promptEnglish: If I had known her address, I would have written to her.
items.hint: The result clause needs past + бы.
items.explanation: The conditional result clause is past tense + бы: я бы написал ей. Without бы it becomes a real past report; напишу is a future form, which бы never combines with.

items.prompt: Если бы Маша часто читала книги, _____.
items.promptEnglish: If she often read books, she would understand Russian well.
items.hint: The frequency cue часто keeps which aspect?
items.explanation: The frequency cue часто keeps the imperfective in both clauses: понимала бы. Поняла would frame one moment of understanding; without бы the clause loses the hypothetical; понимает is present.

items.prompt: Если бы Антон уже сделал работу, _____.
items.promptEnglish: If Anton had already finished his work, he would have gone for a walk.
items.hint: Уже keeps the perfective; the result clause takes past + бы.
items.explanation: The result clause is past + бы: он бы пошёл гулять. Without бы it reports a real walk; идёт is present; пошла is feminine and does not agree with Антон.

items.prompt: _____ статью, он бы согласился со мной.
items.promptEnglish: If Anton had read the article through, he would have agreed with me.
items.explanation: The hypothetical if-clause is если бы + past: Если бы Антон прочитал. Bare если + past reads as a real condition; прочитает is future (бы never takes it); doubling бы inside one clause is ungrammatical.

items.promptEnglish: If we met often, we would understand each other better.
options: мы бы лучше понимали друг друга
мы бы лучше поняли друг друга
мы бы лучше понимаем друг друга
items.answer: мы бы лучше понимали друг друга
items.explanation: The frequency cue часто keeps both verbs imperfective, and the result clause needs бы: мы бы лучше понимали друг друга. Поняли frames a single moment; without бы the hypothesis collapses.

blanks: Если бы Маша уже _____ работу, она бы пошла гулять. (If Masha had already finished her work, she would have gone for a walk.)
fillInBlank.grammarFocus: 'Уже' (already) is a completion adverb (recap from Lesson 3 and A2 Aspect Intro Lesson 5) and locks in the perfective. The conditional does not change this rule. Past fem -ла + бы: сделала. The imperfective делала would describe ongoing work, which 'already finished' contradicts.

errorCorrection.sentence: Если бы Антон наконец убирал квартиру, он бы пригласил друзей.
errorCorrection.translationEnglish: If Anton had finally cleaned the flat, he would have invited friends over.
errorCorrection.explanation: The conditional uses past-tense forms with бы, and aspect follows the ordinary past-tense rules. 'Наконец' (finally) is a completion adverb and locks in the perfective: убрал бы. The imperfective убирал would describe an unfinished cleaning process, which 'finally' contradicts.

errorCorrection.sentence: Если бы дети каждый день сделали зарядку, они бы реже болели.
errorCorrection.translationEnglish: If the children did their exercises every day, they would get sick less often.
errorCorrection.explanation: In the conditional, aspect follows the past-tense rules. 'Каждый день' is a frequency cue and locks in the imperfective: делали бы. The perfective сделали would name a single completed exercise session, which the every-day habitual frame rules out. The result-clause 'реже болели' is likewise imperfective, matching its habitual meaning.

errorCorrection.sentence: Если бы я сумел плавать с детства, я бы сейчас не боялся воды.
errorCorrection.translationEnglish: If I had known how to swim since childhood, I would not be afraid of water now.
errorCorrection.explanation: Уметь is a stative imperfective ('to know how') and stays imperfective in the conditional: умел бы. A skill held since childhood is an enduring state, which only the imperfective expresses. The perfective сумел would mean 'managed to (once)', a single event.

minimalPairs.context: Если бы я _____ её, я бы помог раньше.
minimalPairs.contextEnglish: If I (m) had known her, I would have helped earlier.
minimalPairs.explanation: Знать is impf-only and stays imperfective in the conditional. The result-clause hypothesizes that knowing her was a state, not a single moment of recognition. The perfective узнал would mean 'found out / recognized,' a different lexical event.

minimalPairs.context: Если бы Антон _____ книгу за час, мы бы пошли в кино.
minimalPairs.contextEnglish: If Anton had read the book through in an hour, we would have gone to the cinema.
minimalPairs.explanation: 'За час' is a perfective time-frame cue (A2 Aspect Intro Lesson 5). Perfective past + бы: прочитал. The imperfective читал would describe an hour of process without a completion claim, which the result-clause depends on.

reviewVocab.definition: the conditional mood (built from past-tense forms plus the particle бы; aspect choice follows the same rules as in the past tense)
reviewVocab.example: Условное наклонение строится из формы прошедшего времени и частицы бы.

reviewVocab.definition: if (only) (introduces the hypothetical if-clause; followed by a past-tense verb)
reviewVocab.example: Если бы я знал её адрес, я бы написал ей.

reviewVocab.definition: the conditional particle (attaches to the verb, typically right after it; signals hypothetical rather than actual past meaning)
reviewVocab.example: Я бы прочитал эту книгу за выходные.
